newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks 50,000T American, Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks 50,000T American, Australian wheat.

text.p: The main official in charge of government commodity purchases said on Friday that Egypt was seeking 50,000 tonnes of American, Australian, or French wheat for delivery June 1 to June 14.
Samir Shakankiri, vice chairman for the General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC) told Reuters the type of wheat must be according to GASC specifications.
"The general authoritiy must receive the offers at 10:00 on Saturday and I have the right to cancel this invitation without giving any reason," he said.
The validity of the offer closes at 15:00 Cairo time (1200 GMT) on Monday May 19.
He added that the winner of the bid must submit a freight offer on Friday, May 23 to Maltrans company and submit a copy to the GASC.
